structural_change: CX-IJ 10-18: the two-root ij leaf carries two 3:4 crossings inside one leaf (ijd_slot clk_s -> ipv / ipgb / ibad clk_q, and io_slot clk_q -> idl clk_s, 3 x 1,024 b), the defect that failed routes hbm_su_cx_dl_1017-s2-761317600 (TT -166.7 / FF -95.1) and hbm_su_cx_rc_1017-s2-761317600 (TT -173.4 / FF -77.9): related-clock STA times a 3:4 crossing at the VCO tick (setup 277.8 ps, coincident-edge hold) less the 150 / 100 distinct-entry reserve. Fix (dl/rc split, S81 x34 _s/_t precedent): one root per half; the crossings become 2-bank seams (static calendar windows >= 3 quanta for setup and rewrite-after-read), die-level 3:4 seam arcs. Lockstep vs the hub on Verilator 5.050 PASS QID 2 and QID 0 (checks=24183); mutants 1/2/3/4 FAIL. ij_s (stream, x1 per quarter): W seam to ij_q 2,114 b (5.6/um), E inj_d / request 1,186 b (3.1/um); clock/reset N centre. HH-1 10-18 regate: 216 -> 108 um wide (gate 216 x 388.8, util 1.7%: GPL-0305 RePlAce divergence, no CTS / GRT); 108 x 388.8 keeps both faces <= 6/um, util ~3.5% (closed dl_s 2.6%), ob -> idl -> inj_d runs W -> E over 108 um; the pair abuts as a 324 x 388.8 block (old two-root leaf 388.8 x 388.8). TW2-NATIVE-IJS 10-19 (native_pin_audit of the CLOSED view hbm_su_cx_ijs_1018-x1-4ba37c0fe FAIL: capture 415.9 > 190 on 667 pins, R 256.1): (1) inj_addr / inj_rd sat at the E face TOP (y 332-385) while their jb capture registers serve the W face BOTTOM (y 4-17, mirrored with ij_q): a ~450 um diagonal through the nz/iv decode. Re-pinned the E face (COLL side, die assigns it): inj_addr 4-55, inj_rd 56.2-56.9, inj_d 58.1-384.8 (same densities) -> the decode runs straight across 108 um. The request cannot be pin-flopped before the decode without moving the jb write off edge A (seam setup 3 -> 0 quanta) or RQ=1 (pgslices capture at P+1+RQ: a die-wide calendar change), so it is NOT done. (2) ob0 / ob1 (540 pins, ob0[i] / ob1[i] 182 um apart) met in the wp mux: OBR=1 lands both banks in pin registers at the same edge p and inserts at p+1 into idl[ins+1] (one of the X=2 spare stages): inj_d at P+INJ_RET unchanged, lockstep vs the hub PASS. (3) rst_s_n: ROOT-RST reset_landing 2 stages (DIE: release this tile's rst_s_n 2 stream edges before the phase-zero epoch release).
